Library screening without prior peak-picking

ms2_search.Rd

A direct library screening approach using measurement files and the CSL spectral library in SQLite format.

Usage

ms2_search(
  data_path,
  csl_path,
  chromatography = "bfg_nts_rp1",
  pol = "pos",
  ce_s = 30:40,
  ces_s = 0:15,
  instr = "LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF 5600 SCIEX",
  rtoffset = 0,
  rt_res = 1.5,
  rttolm = 1,
  mztolu = 0.5,
  mztolu_fine = 0.005,
  mztolu_ms2 = 0.015,
  threshold = 400,
  ndp_m = 2,
  ndp_n = 1,
  compounds = NULL
)

Arguments

data_path

Path to rawfiles, can be a vector of file locations or a list of xcmsRaw objects

csl_path

Path to the Collective Spectral Library (CSL)

chromatography

Chromatography name to choose the correct retention times from the library

pol

Polarity

ce_s

Collision energy

ces_s

Collision energy spread

instr

Instruments allowed, must match the instruments listed in the library

rtoffset

Retention time offset (will be added to library RTs)

rt_res

Resolution of two peaks in chromatography (min)

rttolm

Retention time tolerance in minutes

mztolu

m/z tolerance in Da (MS2 precursor mass)

mztolu_fine

m/z tolerance in Da (second stage)

mztolu_ms2

m/z window for dot-product

threshold

Threshold score for spectral comparison (for dot_product 1000 is max)

ndp_m

Peak intensity weighting factor for dot-product

ndp_n

m/z weighting factor for dot-product

compounds

character vector of compounds which should be processed

Value

a `data.frame` with hits from the CSL

Details

The function is used in the Report RC to obtain the peak list. No prior peak picking is needed for this function. The function starts from the list of masses provided in the spectral library and searches for these in the measurement data. The measurement data is in mz(X)ML format and contains DDA MS² spectra. Multiple peaks for one compound Will be sorted by intensity and labelled A-Z # TODO: Check if this is already the case

## References Jewell, K. S., Kunkel, U., Ehlig, B., Thron, F., Schlüsener, M., Dietrich, C., . . . Ternes, T. A. (2019). Comparing mass, retention time and MS2 spectra as criteria for the automated screening of small molecules in aqueous environmental samples analyzed by LC-QToF-MS/MS. Rapid Communications in Mass Spectrometry, 34, e8541. doi:10.1002/rcm.8541
